note: Seafood stew of crab, clams, mussels, prawns and fish in tomato and white wine

steps.text: Slice the fennel and onion and crush the garlic.
Soften in oil.
Add the tomatoes, wine and stock and simmer.
Add the crab, then the clams and mussels, then the prawns and fish, cooking until the shells open.
Serve with sliced sourdough.

note: Slow roasted citrus pork, ham, Swiss and pickles pressed until crisp

dish.make_ahead: Marinate and roast the day before

steps.text: Mix the citrus juices, crushed garlic and oregano and marinate the pork overnight.
Marinate in the fridge.
Roast at 160C, then slice.
Layer the rolls with pork, ham, Swiss cheese, pickles and mustard.
Press in a buttered pan until crisp.

note: Salmon baked in foil with dill butter, crushed potatoes, charred beans

dish.n: Hideout cabin salmon with dill butter

steps.text: Mash the soft butter with the chopped dill, the zest of the lemon and the crushed garlic clove.
Boil the baby potatoes for 15 minutes, drain, crush lightly and toss with the olive oil and salt.
Lay the salmon fillets on squares of foil, top each with a slice of the butter and a lemon slice, then seal.
Bake at 200C for 12 minutes.
Fry the green beans in a hot pan with a splash of oil for 4 minutes until charred.

note: Seared sirloin in a red wine pan sauce, oven chips

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips, toss in oil and roast until crisp.
Sear the steaks in a very hot pan, add butter and baste for a minute, then rest.
Add the red wine and stock to the pan and reduce until glossy.
Slice the steak and serve by candlelight.

note: Rump steak with parsley chimichurri and smashed roast potatoes

steps.text: Boil the baby potatoes 15 minutes, smash on an oiled tray and roast at 220C for 30 minutes.
Chop a bunch of parsley, the garlic cloves and the red chilli and mix with the olive oil, the red wine vinegar and dried oregano.
Season the rump steak and grill on a very hot barbecue 4 minutes a side for medium rare.
Rest 8 minutes, slice and spoon the chimichurri over.
Serve with the potatoes and a dressed green salad.

note: Paprika rubbed ribs baked then glazed, charred corn, Dijon potato salad

dish.n: Smoky pork ribs, corn and potato salad
dish.make_ahead: Ribs up to 1 day ahead, glaze to serve

steps.text: Rub the ribs with the brown sugar, paprika and garlic, then wrap tightly in foil.
Bake at 150C until the meat is very tender.
Boil the potatoes until tender, cool slightly, and toss with Dijon, oil and vinegar.
Unwrap the ribs, brush with barbecue sauce and glaze under a hot grill.
Char the corn on a grill.

note: Chicken thighs simmered in stock with vegetables and self-raising dumplings

steps.text: Chop the vegetables and put everything except the dumpling ingredients in a pot.
Simmer until the chicken is tender.
Shred the chicken back into the pot.
Rub the butter into the flour and mix with the milk.
Drop spoonfuls on top and steam covered.

note: Dry brined rib eye with homemade béarnaise and wilted spinach

dish.n: Benedict's casino rib eye with béarnaise
dish.make_ahead: Salt the steaks the night before

steps.text: Dry-brine the steaks overnight.
Bake the fries at 220C.
Reduce the vinegar with tarragon and the chopped shallot to a spoonful.
Whisk with the yolks over simmering water and drizzle in the warm melted butter.
Wilt the spinach, squeeze and simmer in the cream.
Sear the steaks, pull at 54C and rest.

note: Salmon under a parsley breadcrumb crust, buttery green beans on the side

steps.text: Spread the salmon with Dijon and press on breadcrumbs mixed with parsley and lemon zest.
Roast at 220C.
Boil the potatoes, then crush with butter and salt.
Steam the green beans and toss with butter.

note: Chicken thigh curry in a tomato and coconut milk sauce

dish.make_ahead: Keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Soften the onion in oil with the ginger, garlic and curry powder.
Add the chicken, tomatoes and coconut milk.
Simmer for 40 minutes.
Cook the rice and serve with mango chutney.

note: Seared chicken breast in a shallot, lemon and tarragon cream sauce

dish.n: Eric's castle chicken with tarragon cream

steps.text: Season the chicken and chop the shallot.
Sear the chicken in oil, then finish in a 200C oven and rest.
In the same pan cook the shallot in some of the butter, add the stock and lemon juice and reduce by half.
Add the cream and tarragon and simmer.
Boil the potatoes and toss in the rest of the butter. Steam the beans.

note: Seared tied eye fillet with pommes Anna, the layered potato cake

dish.n: Molly Brown's first class filet mignon

steps.text: Layer the potatoes with melted butter in a pan, season and bake at 200C for 50 minutes for pommes Anna.
Tie the steaks, sear in butter and roast to 54C.
Reduce the shallots, wine and stock to a sauce in the steak pan.
Steam the beans and serve everything together.

note: Seared beef patties with onion gravy

dish.make_ahead: Gravy up to 2 days, cook patties fresh

steps.text: Shape the mince into 4 patties and season.
Cook the rice.
Sear the patties until cooked through and set aside.
Soften the sliced onion in the pan, stir in the flour and stock and simmer.
Fry the eggs. Serve the patties on rice, topped with a fried egg and the gravy.

note: the steak sandwich Axel puts on someone else's tab

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into fries, toss with oil and bake at 220C, turning halfway.
While the fries bake, slowly cook the sliced onions in butter until caramelised.
Mix the mayonnaise with the horseradish.
Season the steak and sear hard in a hot pan.
Rest the steak, then slice thin.
Toast the rolls and fill with steak, onions, Swiss cheese and horseradish mayo.
Serve with the fries alongside.

note: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and onion, two per bun

steps.text: Roll the mince into 12 balls and slice the onion.
Smash thin on a hot griddle in batches, salt, and flip after 90 seconds, adding cheese.
Toast the buns.
Stack two patties per bun with pickles and onion and pile onto a platter.

note: Garlic thyme beef blade roasted tender with potatoes, carrots and gravy

dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, reheat gently

steps.text: Rub the beef with the garlic, thyme and salt.
Roast covered at 160C for 2 hours, then add the potatoes and carrots to the tray.
Roast for another hour until the beef is tender.
Lift out the beef and vegetables to rest. Whisk the flour into the pan juices, add the stock and simmer into gravy. Serve after church.

note: Slow-simmered beef chilli with cumin and chilli powder

steps.text: Brown the beef mince in a heavy pot.
Add the diced onion and the garlic cloves for 5 minutes, then the cumin, the chilli powder and the chipotle in adobo.
Stir in the tinned tomatoes, the beef stock and the dark chocolate and simmer 45 minutes.
Add the drained tins kidney beans for the last 15 minutes.
Serve with sour cream, grated cheddar, pickled jalapeños and crusty bread.

note: Chicken thighs braised in sweet paprika with onion and capsicum

steps.text: Brown the chicken thighs, then soften the onions and the red capsicum in the pan.
Stir in the sweet paprika, add the chicken stock and the chicken, and simmer 30 minutes.
Stir the sour cream through off the heat and serve over the buttered egg noodles.

note: Roast chicken, pigs in blankets, roast potatoes, maple sprouts, gravy

ingredients.item: rashers streaky bacon (8 to wrap, 4 to fry)

steps.text: Rub the chicken with butter and salt.
Roast at 200C.
Wrap the chipolatas in half rashers of bacon and add for the last part of the roasting.
Roast the parboiled potatoes in oil.
Fry the sprouts with diced bacon, then toss with maple syrup.
Make gravy from the pan juices with the flour and stock.

film: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story (2016)
note: Lamb, carrots and basmati rice cooked with cumin and cinnamon

dish.make_ahead: Pilaf can be reheated, serve with fresh almonds

steps.text: Brown the lamb in the oil. Add the onion, carrots, cumin and cinnamon and cook 5 minutes.
Stir in the rice and stock, cover and cook on low.
Rest the pilaf, covered, for 10 minutes. Toast the almonds meanwhile.
Pile onto a platter with the raisins and almonds. Serve with yoghurt mixed with the garlic.

note: Chicken and chorizo paella with saffron rice and prawns

steps.text: Slice the chorizo, dice the onion and capsicum, and crush the garlic. Heat the stock with the saffron.
Brown the chicken and chorizo in a wide pan.
Add the onion, garlic, capsicum and paprika and cook until soft.
Stir in the rice and hot stock, then cook without stirring.
Push the prawns into the rice for the last 5 minutes, then rest briefly before serving.

note: Beef mince sauce with carrot and celery, tossed through spaghetti and parmesan

steps.text: Dice the carrots and celery.
Brown the mince.
Add the carrot and celery and soften.
Add the tomatoes and simmer.
Boil the spaghetti until al dente.
Toss with the sauce and plenty of parmesan.

film: Things to Do in Denver When You're Dead (1995)
note: the diner booth where the job gets planned

dish.make_ahead: Onions can be cooked 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Cook the onions in a little of the butter over low heat until soft and golden.
Shape the mince into 4 thin oval patties, season, and sear in a hot pan until browned on both sides.
Butter the bread on the outside. Build each sandwich with a patty, onions and two slices of Swiss cheese.
Griddle the sandwiches in a pan over medium heat, turning once, until crisp and the cheese has melted.

note: Seared rib eye steaks with crisp roast potatoes

steps.text: Parboil the potatoes, then shake to rough up.
Roast in hot oil at 220C until crisp.
Season the steaks and sear in a very hot pan, basting with butter for the last minute.
Rest the steaks.
In the same pan add the peppercorns and brandy, then cream and stock, and simmer until thick.
Slice and spoon the sauce over.

note: Rib roast, roast potatoes, Yorkshire puddings and gravy

dish.make_ahead: Rest 20 minutes before carving

steps.text: Season the beef well and leave overnight if possible.
Heat the oven to 220C and roast the beef, then drop to 160C until 52C inside.
Rest the beef under foil.
Roast the potatoes in oil.
Whisk the eggs, flour and milk and bake in hot oiled tins at 220C.
Make gravy with the stock and pan juices.

note: Salami, ham and provolone with lettuce, tomato, onion, oil and red wine vinegar

dish.make_ahead: Up to 4 hours ahead, wrap tight

steps.text: Split the rolls and layer with the salami, ham, provolone, lettuce, tomato and onion.
Drizzle with oil and vinegar and sprinkle with oregano. Wrap tight and cut in half.

note: Lager battered flathead fillets, twice-fried chips, cabbage slaw and tartare

steps.text: Cut the potatoes into chips and dry well
Shred the cabbage and toss with mayo and vinegar
Fry the chips twice, once to cook through and once to crisp
Whisk the flour with cold lager into a batter, dip the fish and fry until golden
Serve with tartare

note: Chicken thighs, mushrooms and leeks in a white wine cream sauce

steps.text: Brown the chicken in oil
Soften the mushrooms and leeks
Add the wine and cream and simmer until thick
Tip into a dish, cover with puff pastry and brush with egg
Bake at 200C until golden

note: Smashed beef patties with American cheese, pickles and mustard ketchup sauce

dish.make_ahead: Patties shaped up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Shape the mince into balls ready to smash. Mix the mustard and tomato sauce.
Heat a griddle until smoking. Smash each ball into a thin patty, season and cook for 2 minutes a side, adding cheese at the end.
Toast the buns. Stack two patties per bun with sauce, pickles and onion.
Plate on fine china with silver cutlery and linen napkins.

note: Lamb and carrot pie in Worcestershire gravy under baked buttery mash

dish.n: Shepherd's pie she passes off as hers
dish.make_ahead: Up to 1 day, assemble then bake

steps.text: Dice the onion and carrots. Peel and chop the potatoes.
Brown the mince, add the onion and carrot, then the tomato paste, Worcestershire sauce and water. Simmer.
Boil the potatoes and mash with the butter and milk.
Top the mince with the mash and bake at 200C until golden.

note: Spatchcock chicken roasted over potatoes and carrots, glazed with honey

steps.text: Spatchcock the chicken and cut the potatoes and carrots into chunks.
Lay the chicken over the vegetables, season and drizzle with oil.
Roast at 220C.
Warm the honey with the garlic and thyme, brush over and roast until glossy.
Rest and pull apart to share.

note: Grilled pork sausage, roast pork, pepper slaw and peppercorn sauce in pita

steps.text: Grill the sausages until cooked through.
Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayo and plenty of black pepper.
Reduce the shallot, stock, cream and cracked pepper into a sauce.
Warm the roast pork and the pitas.
Fill the pitas with sausage, pork, slaw and sauce and wrap tightly.

note: Big rump steak with garlic butter, onion rings, roast potatoes, ranch wedge

steps.text: Rub the steak with oil and salt. Toss the potatoes in oil.
Roast the potatoes at 220C.
Grill the steak over high heat for medium rare.
Rest the steak. Bake the onion rings.
Melt the butter with the garlic. Drizzle the lettuce wedges with ranch.
Slice the steak thickly, pour over the garlic butter and serve.

note: Slow cooked beef chuck chili with chipotle and cumin

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days

steps.text: Cut the beef and brown in batches in oil
Soften the onions and garlic
Add the chipotle, cumin, tomatoes, beans and beef
Cover and braise at 160C
Bake the cornbread as the packet says and serve alongside

note: Tarragon lemon butter roast chicken with potatoes and green beans

steps.text: Push the butter mixed with chopped tarragon and lemon zest under the skin of the chicken.
Roast at 200C for 75 minutes with the potatoes in chunks around it.
Steam the green beans and toss in the pan juices.

note: Two lemon thyme roast chickens with potatoes, carrots and pan gravy

steps.text: Rub the chickens with lemon, thyme, oil and salt and set in a large roasting tray with the potatoes and carrots.
Roast at 200C until the chicken is golden and cooked through and the vegetables are tender.
Rest the chickens on a board.
Make gravy in the tray with the flour, juices and stock.
Carve and serve at a big farmhouse table.

note: Grilled bratwurst with apple caraway sauerkraut and warm pretzels

steps.text: Simmer the sauerkraut with the grated apple, apple juice and caraway.
Grill the bratwurst over medium heat, turning, until browned all over.
Warm the pretzels at 180C.
Serve together with plenty of wholegrain mustard.

note: Teriyaki chicken thigh skewers, grilled and basted, with steamed rice

dish.make_ahead: Chicken can marinate up to 4 hours

steps.text: Toss the chicken in the teriyaki sauce, ginger and garlic.
Marinate.
Thread onto skewers.
Grill, turning and basting.
Steam the rice.
Serve with sesame seeds.

film: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1 (2010)
note: Whole trout stuffed with lemon, dill and butter, cooked in foil

steps.text: Stuff the trout with lemon slices, dill and butter and season.
Wrap in oiled foil.
Cook on a hot barbecue or at 200C.
Boil the potatoes until tender.
Toss the potatoes in butter and parsley.
Serve the trout in its foil.

note: Snapper rubbed with lime and chilli, grilled in banana leaf, coconut rice

steps.text: Soften the banana leaves in hot water. Rub the fish with lime juice, chilli and salt.
Wrap each fillet in a leaf.
Cook the rice in the coconut milk with a pinch of salt and a splash of water.
Grill the parcels.
Serve the fish in its leaf on the rice.

note: Beef braised 3 hours with onions, sweet paprika and caraway

dish.make_ahead: Better the next day, keeps 3 days chilled

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in a hot heavy pot.
Cook the onions slowly for 20 minutes, then stir in the paprika, caraway and tomato paste.
Add the water, return the beef and cover. Braise at 160C for 3 hours.
Season and serve with crusty bread.

note: Chicken, carrots and celery in a creamy broth with self-raising dumplings

steps.text: Dice the vegetables
Simmer the chicken with the vegetables and stock
Shred the meat and add the cream
Rub the butter into the flour, then mix in parsley and milk
Drop spoonfuls on top, cover and cook

note: Deep pan pizza loaded with mozzarella, provolone, cheddar and pepperoni

steps.text: Oil a deep tray and press the dough in.
Cover and prove until puffy.
Spread with sauce and pile on all four cheeses and the pepperoni.
Bake at 220C until molten and golden.

note: Ziti baked in Italian sausage tomato sauce with melted cheese

steps.text: Squeeze the sausages from their skins and brown, breaking them up.
Add garlic, passata and chilli flakes and simmer.
Boil the pasta for 2 minutes less than the packet says.
Toss with the sauce, spread in a baking dish and dot with ricotta.
Top with mozzarella and parmesan and bake at 200C.

note: Thyme butter roast chicken with potatoes and carrots

steps.text: Rub the chicken with the butter, thyme and salt.
Roast at 200C.
Add the potatoes and carrots to the tray and keep roasting.
Rest the chicken before carving.

note: Chicken thighs simmered with ginger, garlic, garam masala, tomato and cream, rice and naan

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Soften the onion, ginger and garlic in the oil.
Add the garam masala, tomatoes and chicken.
Simmer until the chicken is tender.
Cook the rice.
Stir the cream into the curry and serve with rice and warm naan.

note: Annie's order that horrifies Alvy

ingredients.item: jar yellow mustard, on the side
slices rye bread, on the side

steps.text: Steam the pastrami until glossy.
Spread the white bread with mayonnaise.
Add lettuce and tomato and pile the pastrami high.
Put rye and mustard on the side for anyone who wants it.

note: hearty, nothing from below ground

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Brown the beef in batches in oil.
Add the onions, carrots, celery and tomato paste and cook.
Add the stock, cover and braise at 160C.
Add the potatoes and braise for the last hour.
Serve with Italian bread.

note: Orange and cumin pork shoulder braised, then crisped, in corn tortillas

steps.text: Cut the pork into chunks and rub with cumin, oregano and salt.
Braise at 160C with the orange, garlic and water.
Shred the pork.
Crisp in a hot pan with oil.
Serve in tortillas with diced onion, coriander and lime.

note: Beef and pork meatloaf with a sticky glaze, creamy mashed potato

steps.text: Soak the breadcrumbs in some of the milk, then mix with the minces, onion, egg, Worcestershire, salt and pepper.
Press into a lined loaf tin. Mix the tomato sauce, sugar and vinegar and spread over the top.
Bake at 180C, then rest.
Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash with most of the butter and the rest of the milk.
Cook the peas and toss with the remaining butter. Slice the meatloaf and serve with mash and peas.

film: Jay and Silent Bob Strike Back (2001)
note: Two smashed beef patties, American cheese, pickles and special sauce

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Roll the mince into 8 balls. Mix the mayonnaise with tomato sauce.
Smash the balls flat on a smoking griddle, season and cook, then flip, add cheese and cook a minute more.
Stack 2 patties per toasted bun with pickles and sauce, then wrap in paper.

note: Browned pork sausages, mash and onion gravy

steps.text: Slice the onions and peel the potatoes.
Brown the sausages slowly in a pan.
Cook the onions in the same pan until soft.
Add the stock and simmer until thick.
Boil the potatoes until tender and mash with butter and milk.
Cook the peas.
Serve the sausages on the mash with peas and plenty of gravy.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean: At World's End (2007)
note: Crab pieces in a sweet chili tomato sauce with egg ribbons, crusty bread to mop up

dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

ingredients.item: blue swimmer crabs, cleaned and cut into pieces

steps.text: Fry the garlic, ginger and chilli in the oil. Add the tomato sauce, sweet chilli, soy and water.
Add the crab, cover and cook until the shells turn red.
Stir in the beaten eggs until just set. Serve with crusty bread.

note: Shaved rib eye with onion, capsicum and provolone

dish.make_ahead: Best fresh

steps.text: Freeze the steak until firm, which is the resting time, then shave thin.
Slice the onions and capsicum.
Fry the onion and capsicum on a hot plate until soft.
Add the beef and sear fast.
Lay the provolone on top to melt and pile into the rolls.

film: The Chronicles of Narnia: Prince Caspian (2008)
note: Lamb shoulder simmered with pearl barley, carrots, leeks and rosemary

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Slice the carrots and leeks.
Brown the lamb in oil.
Add the barley, vegetables, rosemary and water and simmer until the lamb is tender.
Serve in deep bowls with crusty bread.

note: Roast pumpkin and carrot soup with a sour cream spiderweb on top

dish.make_ahead: Soup up to 3 days, reheat to serve

steps.text: Heat the oven to 200C. Roast the pumpkin, carrots, garlic and thyme in oil until soft.
Blend with the hot stock until smooth.
Pour into bowls.
Pipe circles of sour cream on top and drag a skewer from the centre outwards to make a spiderweb.

note: Chicken thighs braised in soy, ginger and star anise, over jasmine rice

dish.make_ahead: Up to 2 days, reheats well

steps.text: Slice the ginger.
Brown the chicken in the oil.
Add the soy sauce, water, ginger, star anise and sugar.
Braise until glossy and tender.
Cook the jasmine rice.
Stir-fry the bok choy with garlic.

note: Yogurt and spice marinated chicken skewers, saffron basmati, garlic sauce, pickles

dish.make_ahead: Marinate a day ahead

steps.text: Mix the yoghurt, crushed garlic, spices and lemon juice and coat the chicken.
Marinate in the fridge overnight.
Skewer the chicken and grill hot until charred and cooked through.
Cook the basmati with the saffron.
Serve with garlic sauce and pickles.

note: Crumbed chicken with passata, ham and mozzarella, chips and salad

steps.text: Halve the large chicken breasts into thin fillets.
Crumb in flour, the eggs and the breadcrumbs and pan-fry until golden.
Top with the passata, the ham and the grated mozzarella and bake at 200C for 12 minutes.
Serve with chips and salad.

note: Grilled rosemary lamb chops, mashed potatoes, peas and mint sauce

dish.n: Mr Wilson's lamb chops with mint sauce
dish.make_ahead: Make fresh

steps.text: Rub the chops with rosemary, garlic and salt.
Boil the potatoes until soft, drain and mash with the butter.
Grill the chops, 3 minutes a side, then rest. Cook the peas.
Serve everything with a spoon of mint sauce, in peace, with no interruptions at all.

note: Beef and kidney bean chili simmered 90 minutes, sour cream and cheddar

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, keep chilled

steps.text: Brown the mince with the onion and chilli powder.
Add the tomatoes and kidney beans.
Simmer until thick.
Serve in bowls topped with sour cream and cheddar.

note: for the fixer who makes problems go away

dish.make_ahead: Onions up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Slice the onions.
Cook the onions in the butter over low heat until jammy.
Sear the steaks hard on both sides, rest, then slice thin.
Split and toast the ciabatta, spread with horseradish cream and pile with steak, onions and rocket.

film: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels (1998)
note: Beef and ale pie under puff pastry, thick twice fried chips, crushed peas

dish.make_ahead: Filling up to 2 days ahead

steps.text: Brown the beef with the sliced onions and thyme.
Add the ale and braise.
Thicken with the flour, pour into a dish, cover with puff pastry and bake at 200C.
Cut thick chips and fry twice until golden.
Cook the peas and crush with the butter and mint.

note: Griddled franks in steamed buns with sauerkraut, mustard, onion and relish

steps.text: Simmer the franks, then griddle until blistered.
Warm the sauerkraut in a small pan.
Steam the buns and chop the onion.
Fill the buns with franks, mustard, onion, relish and sauerkraut.

note: Beef chuck, carrots and potatoes braised for 3 hours, with crusty bread

dish.make_ahead: Up to 3 days, better the next day

steps.text: Dice the beef, onions, carrots and potatoes.
Brown the beef in batches, then soften the onion and carrot.
Add the potatoes, stock and thyme, cover and braise at 160C until the meat falls apart.
Serve with crusty bread.

note: Lime and cumin marinated skirt steak in corn tortillas with dried chili salsa

dish.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day, keep chilled

steps.text: Marinate the steak in lime juice, three of the garlic cloves and the cumin in the fridge.
Soak the dried chillies in hot water, then blitz with the tomato and remaining garlic for a salsa roja.
Grill the steak on high heat, then rest and slice against the grain.
Warm the tortillas and serve with the steak, salsa, onion and coriander.

note: Wok chicken and egg noodles in oyster sauce, with egg fried rice on the side

steps.text: Slice the chicken, shred the cabbage and slice the spring onions
Stir-fry the chicken in a smoking wok until browned
Add the cabbage, bean sprouts and noodles and toss with the oyster sauce, soy and sesame oil
Scramble the eggs in a second pan, add the rice and spring onion and fry until hot, then serve alongside

note: Grilled barramundi topped with a green mango, mint and chilli salad

steps.text: Score the barramundi fillets and season.
Grill skin down over high heat for 5 minutes, flip for 2.
Toss the shredded green mango with mint, the sliced chilli, the juice of the limes and the fish sauce and pile on top.
